notes.title: Othello: Daynight Time Clash V0.8.2 is now updated
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support to our team. In V0.8.2 we have made the following updates.

Version V0.8.2 updates include.
-New Features:
1.Window full screen and window resolution can be adjusted in Setting.
2.Resign will be allowed in Matching and Friend Versus.
3.History added replay function. (The games recorded in the game are limited to the Matching games and Friend Versus games. The games in Story mode will not be recorded.)

-Optimized Features:
1.Stickers window can be closed by clicking the button again when the stickers　window was open In Matching and Friend Versus.
2.When the mouse left-click on an empty square, you can leave the square and release the mouse to cancel the placing.
3.Optimize the bottom UI effect when the resolution is not enough on both sides in long screen resolution.
4.The hint point will be more obvious in the games.
5.Increase the last placing hint in the games.
6.The round time will increase to 10 second and the total time will increase to 3 minutes in Matching.

-New characters:
For EA version release commemorative,the following new characters are Steam version only available .
The Polar Day: Raphael
The Eternal Night: Lilith

V0.8.2 version is now updated.If you encounter other bug problems, welcome to feedback in the Steam community, thank you for your support!

KingMoon  
August 13, 2022

notes.title: Othello: Daynight Time Clash July Update Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Chessmates:
Thank you for your support to our team. Since the game has been online for 10 days, we have received many valuable comments and suggestions, and we have made the following plans for next update in July.

V0.8.1 version update preview as follows:
-New Features:
1.Window full screen and window resolution can be adjusted in Setting.
2.Resign will be allowed in Matching and Friend Versus.
-Optimized Features:
1.Stickers window can be closed by clicking the button again when the stickers　window was open In Matching and Friend Versus.
2.When the mouse left-click on an empty square, you can leave the square and release the mouse to cancel the placing.
3.Optimize the bottom UI effect when the resolution is not enough on both sides in long screen resolution.
4.The hint point will be more obvious in the games.
5.Increase the last placing hint in the games.
6.The round time will increase to 10 second and the total time will increase to 3 minutes in Matching.
-New characters:
For EA version release commemorative,the following new characters are Steam version only available .
The Polar Day: Raffaele
The Eternal Night: Lilith

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42322876/a0aadd2fd2b54fe72754b2b3e41f27e6b6a8a5d5.png[/img]

V0.8.2 version update will be released in late July, the game is still in EA version, the story and character voices will be added in subsequent versions. If you encounter other bug problems, welcome to feedback in the Steam community, thank you for your support!

KingMoon

notes.title: Othello：Daynight Time Clash 6/17 Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42322876/897aaa3e3fd3c7b3cf3039df9b5ee897aa77101c.png[/img]

Dear Chessmates:
The game will be updated at 00:30 ~ 01:30(UTC -8) on June 17, 2022.
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to log into the game. To ensure the safety of your game account data, Please go offline before the maintenance. Please understand for the inconvenience caused to you! Thank you for your support. 
V0.8.1 version specific update maintenance content as follows:
Bug Fixes
1.Fixed the issue that cause by the communication lead to the bug that the player is still deducting his time after his move in the Matching games and Friend Versus games.For the same reason,there may also be the same situation after the opponent’s move.
2.Fixed the issue that unable to end the game when both sides are unable to place in the Matching games and Friend Versus games.
3.Fixed the issue of the computer will take a long time to make a move at the closing stage of the game in the Story mode.
4.Fixed the issue of the computer will not be able to make a move in Story mode due to multiple fast clicks on the board, but there are hints that you can click or the computer will automatically make a move without any display.
5.Fixed the issue that cannot unlocking the DLC CG in the Story mode final settlement.
If you encounter other bug problems, welcome to feedback in the Steam community, thank you for your support!

    KingMoon
June 16th,2022

notes.title: Othello：Daynight Time Clash has finally launched in Early Access.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42322876/897aaa3e3fd3c7b3cf3039df9b5ee897aa77101c.png[/img]

Dear Chessmates:

Thanks for joining the Daynight Time Clash while the game is still in development.

In this Early Access version, you can enjoy Online Matching & Friend Versus with 10 characters. New characters are coming soon. Character voices, Scenarios and other Functions will be added with the version updates. Bugfixes and Optimizations are also important.

The Daynight Time Clash is coming! Let's Othello!
